archetypes.name: dyn-origin-allowlist
archetypes.rationale: Origin scanning must use unsqueezed root-cause bodies only and preserve repeated headings.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect classify_origin and _origin_source_texts against the plan allowlist. Confirm markers in summary, suggested-fix, title-only value text, and post-plan bodies are ignored; markers past ROOT_CAUSE_CAP and FREEFORM_CAP still classify; repeated Root Cause headings are examined in document order with first-match precedence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
